sv.title: Mördade Karen Snider med 125 hugg – dömd efter 60 år
sv.summary: 18-åriga Karen Snider mördades med 125 hugg. Vännen James Barbier var med och bar hennes kista vid begravningen. 60 år senare har han dömts för att ha mördat henne, skriver People.

en.title: Murdered Karen Snider With 125 Stab Wounds – Convicted After 60 Years
en.summary: 18-year-old Karen Snider was murdered with 125 stab wounds. Her friend James Barbier helped carry her coffin at the funeral. 60 years later, he has been convicted of murdering her, writes People.
